label: Late original phase / <DEL> in sequences that start with digit 2
explanation: Fires on the steps after the first two inputs, through the <DEL> step, when the sequence opens with the digit 2 (first_tok=2 gives 12x lift and 59% of activation mass; 95% precision when first_tok=2 and t>=2). A 2 in position 1 also triggers it, but more weakly and later. Strongest when the sequence starts with repeated 2s (e.g. 2 2 2 ...). The activation ramps up a few steps after the 2s and decays across later tokens and the <DEL>. It carries into the first one or two copy outputs, which are then the 2s being recalled. Weak, diffuse low-magnitude firing (mostly bottom quartile) also appears in the middle of the original phase of sequences without an early 2, especially ones starting with k/h or containing many digits. It never fires at t=0 or t=1 and is nearly silent in the copy phase past recall_idx 1.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=2 (+8.50), phase=2 & in_tok=2 (+7.00), phase=2 & out_tok=2 (+5.58), next_out=2 (+5.46), orig1=2 (+5.37), orig2=2 (+3.75). Lower it: prev2_tok=- (-9.63), phase=2 (-8.61), out_tok=f (-5.55), phase=2 & in_tok=r (-5.12).
